settings.text: Can’t make it to the lab? Mail in your order and enjoy the same fast turnaround and premium quality we’re known for.

settings.category_title: How To Mail Us Your Film
settings.answer_1:
Create and submit your order using our online order form

We’ll send a payment link once your film has been collected and arrives at the lab.
settings.answer_2: Pack your rolls (see our packaging tips below) and include your name and contact so we can match your package to your order.
settings.answer_3: Where possible, use a service with a tracking number. Once your package reaches the lab, turnaround times are the same as for in-person drop-offs.
settings.answer_4: You can choose to collect or have negatives mailed out. Our negative storage policies can be found in our FAQ.

settings.title: Place your order
settings.content: Fill out our [online form]. Pay now or later; we’ll send a link once your film arrives.

settings.title: Pack it
settings.content: Include your order number, name, and contact details.

settings.title: Send it
settings.content: We’ll process your film with the same care as in-person orders. Turnaround is identical once your films have reached us

settings.title: Get your negatives
settings.content: Pick them up or have them mailed. Details in our FAQ.

settings.text:
Your film’s journey matters just as much as its time in our lab. To keep it safe in transit, we recommend to

  • Seal your film in a plastic bag to guard against weather.
  • Use a padded bag (or sturdy box with cushioning).
  • Avoid loose or flimsy packaging - we’d hate for your film to arrive damaged.
  • Please include your return address (marked “Sender,”) on the outside.

Leave the rest to us - we’ll let you know when your film arrives and your order is in-progress !
